name: Memphis Parts Distribution Center - Memphis TN

fieldNotes.location: Address 5745 Challenge Drive in the MDC (Memphis Distribution Center) industrial park, Hickory Hill, Memphis TN 38115 — confirmed via web (Daimler careers page, LoopNet parcel APN 09-3400-0-0603). Roster geocode moved 3,427 m; the corrected pin landed on a large warehouse in the MDC park. Center locked at 35.037650, -89.874050 on that building. Note: MDC is a multi-tenant park (5625 = Bldg K, 5750 = Bldg J, Cummins at 5800); DTNA leases the 5745 suite. The exact tenant footprint and dock allocation cannot be isolated from imagery alone — medium confidence on the precise building/zone boundaries.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or guarded checkpoint on the truck side. Dock corridors are internal MDC park roads, open. A chain-link fence around the south-end CAR parking lot has an open vehicle gate — that is car-park perimeter security, not a truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed at any truck driveway or dock corridor. A green box near the SW corner is a utility transformer cabinet.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long warehouse with a continuous dock-door rhythm along the entire east long face plus the north end; well over 50 doors total — 50+ band. Count is an honest estimate from overhead imagery (~60), flagged uncertain because the building is multi-tenant.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Truck courts on the east and north are densely packed with parked trailers (50+) plus trailers backed into docks. dropYard true; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Roughly 70 trailers counted across the east and north truck courts in captured imagery — estimate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two separate building faces (east long face and north end) could function as separate ship/receive clusters; inferred, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide internal dock corridors easily stage 3+ trucks before the docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Ample paved truck-court width in the internal corridors — room for a bypass lane.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: The DTNA PDC occupies one warehouse, but the MDC park has many adjacent buildings; counted as 1 for the audited building, flagged uncertain given the campus context.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~24 acres for the single audited building plus its truck courts; approximate, flagged uncertain due to multi-tenant boundaries.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense industrial fabric within the City of Memphis (Hickory Hill); Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the audited building's property.
